rules.reference: Every b1_1c3 RX frame; previous sample only

labels.normal_request_candidate: ACC on, no pedal, hold flag off, active ordinary 2B0, 1C3 raw10=0
labels.coordinated_braking_candidate: ACC on, no pedal, moving, hold flag off, active special 2B0, 1C3 raw10>0
labels.stopped_hold_candidate: Speed<=0.1m/s and 30F bit4 on; other fields are not required to agree
labels.other_observed_combination: Fresh inputs outside those definitions; not a new ECU mode
labels.unknown_stale: At least one required prior stream missing or too old

limitations: Observational labels only, not executable control states or acceptance conditions.
CAN Event timestamps are batches; edge offsets are not hardware latency or causal order.
TX means sendcan request, not on-wire transmission or ECU acceptance; matching RX may be passed through.
carControl is absent from these archives; absence of TX cancel does not establish pure OEM behavior.
Hold flag runs are candidates; stopped_samples and contradictory signatures must be inspected.
Other-context counts overlap; intervals across >30ms gaps are excluded, not interpolated.
Nearest edges within +/-500ms may be unrelated; no fixed waiting-time rule is inferred.
